troubleshooting.solution: Check Projection Axis and Scale parameters. Try different Texture Method.
Enable Fix Face Seams or switch Apply to Vertex texture (fix seams).
Ensure Output Attribute Scope is set to Tex. The Texture Method alone does not create the attribute — output scope must be explicitly set.

description: Creates Tex attribute for applying texture maps to surfaces. Supports multiple projection methods: XYZ, Cylindrical, Face, Equirectangular (VR), Equidistant Azimuth (dome), Perspective (projection mapping), and Triplanar.
